kinds.d: Coiled flexible rule that retracts into a case.
Straight body with liquid vials showing level or plumb.
Hand-held device that measures distance with a laser beam.
Self-levelling laser projecting horizontal and vertical lines for setting out.
Laser with a spinning head that sweeps a 360-degree level plane, read by a detector on site.
Telescope on a tripod that sights a level line onto a staff, for site levels.
